cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: Darius sent a fleet in 490 BC to punish Athens and Eretria for supporting the Ionian Revolt; Eretria was sacked

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: The Persian force landed at Marathon, guided by the exiled Athenian tyrant Hippias

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: The Athenians marched to Marathon and were joined by 1,000 Plataeans; they were heavily outnumbered

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: Miltiades persuaded the Athenians to attack; the Greeks strengthened their wings and thinned their centre

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: The Greek wings crushed the Persian flanks, then turned inward to envelop the Persian centre — a decisive victory

cards.front: Recall a key point about The Battle of Marathon (490 BC)
cards.back: Pheidippides allegedly ran 150 miles to Sparta to request help (Sparta arrived after the battle due to a religious festival)
